newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-JUVENTUS COACH SLAMS TEAM CAPTAIN BAN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-JUVENTUS COACH SLAMS TEAM CAPTAIN BAN.

text.p: Juventus coach Marcello Lippi criticised Italian soccer's sporting judge on Thursday for giving team captain Antonio Conte a two-match suspension for being sent off in a pre-season friendly.
"Conte did not do anything...but aside from the specific offence, it is absurd for friendly matches to be treated so harshly," the European Cup-winning coach said.
Milan's Montenegrin attacker Dejan Savicevic also received a two-match suspension for being sent off after clashing with Conte on the pitch in the August 21 match.
Both miss the weekend's season-opening matches but not European club competition ties in midweek.
Lippi said that although pre-season matches were very competitive and against top opponents, they remained friendly and it was unfair to penalise clubs in the league.
He said Juventus, who play Manchester United in their opening Champions League match next week, would appeal against the ban, hoping for it to be at least reduced.
